records.text: [context:qualifications] Every predecessor entry q1–q925 in predecessor_qualifications.json is incorporated in full by reference, including all substantive restrictions, nonblocking findings, historical attributions, authorization boundaries and evidence limitations. This review supersedes none. The expressly authorized M06DR supersession of graph-only A03 coverage remains operative through stationaryAssetSupply_joint_continuous. Historical inspection claims, verification counts, documentation omissions and then-unformalized statuses retain their originating-gate attribution.

[context:qualifications; dep:P01; ledger:NP01] P01 remains original/shifted budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. Original-price normalization retains R=1+r; original/net assets remain distinct from shifted assets and resources. P02 retains its fixed-cap/floor qualifications, separate zero-rate treatment and positive-rate natural-limit branch. NP01 uses original asset coordinates directly and assumes no natural floor.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994.discounted_budget_telescope] The broader bounded-utility, continuous-state and general compactly supported iid-income scope is preserved, including permitted atoms without density or finite-support restrictions. NP01 itself is distribution-free finite algebra. It constructs no stochastic path space, filtration or infinite-horizon lifetime random variable and proves no almost-sure No-Ponzi implication. Later stochastic applications must retain their own feasibility-event and timing obligations.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A1/BudgetTelescope.lean] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive resources. Economic zero uses zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal, potentially infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal remains distinct. All predecessor finite-marginal, positivity, envelope and Euler qualifications remain operative. NP01 uses no marginal object, integral, extended-real conversion or convergence argument and establishes no boundary finiteness, marginal integrability or moment convergence.

[source:A93; source:A94; verify:sources] Both extracted source pages were rendered in memory with Ghostscript and visually inspected without OCR. Extraction page 1 of A93 corresponds to printed p.37/original PDF p.38; extraction page 1 of A94 corresponds to printed p.666/original PDF p.9. A93 displays the finite telescope; A94 note 16 supports the broader present-value/borrowing-limit relationship. The Lean induction is project reconstruction. Extracted PDF hashes matched the source index; original-source hash validation relies on packaged controller evidence.

No external checkout, raw logs or predecessor proof bodies were inspected.

It establishes neither existence nor nonnegativity nor vanishing of an infinite-horizon discounted asset limit, and neither direction of the natural-floor/No-Ponzi equivalence. [lean:Aiyagari1994.M10A2.naturalBound_implies_noPonzi_ae; ledger:NP02; context:gate] NP02 proves the forward implication for arbitrary measure spaces and raw paths satisfying datewise almost-everywhere feasibility and floor conditions. It intersects all countably many datewise premises before applying the pathwise theorem. It neither constructs an infinite iid probability space nor proves adaptation; these are unnecessary for this implication. NP03 retains its separate infinite-path, independence, essential-support and before-current-shock timing obligations. No finite-history law is silently interpreted as an infinite-path law.

[lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A2/NaturalNoPonzi.lean; context:qualifications] Both discounted series are proved summable before their real sums are used to identify the terminal limit. The conclusion is pathwise real convergence almost everywhere. It asserts neither integrability of the random limit nor convergence of expectations, moments or distributions. No ENNReal-to-Real conversion occurs. Existing weak-convergence and moment qualifications remain unchanged.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/PathSpace.lean] The broader household model retains bounded utility, continuous resources and general compactly supported IID labor laws. Atoms are allowed; density and finite support are unnecessary. NP03 uses real original assets and consumption, the compact labor subtype, its probability law, r>0, w>0, measurable prefix plans, datewise almost-sure nonnegative consumption and budget equality, and the stated terminal-limit premise. IncomeSupport and the full IncomeNondegenerate profile remain explicit, although positive lower support, endpoint separation and upper-neighborhood mass are not needed by the core contradiction. Utility, discount preferences and optimality introduce no hidden assumptions.

[dep:NP01; lean:Aiyagari1994/Budget/EffectiveLimit.lean; context:qualifications] P01 remains original/shifted budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. NP01 remains finite budget algebra with terminal exponent T. NP03 uses R=1+r and the original/net asset floor -w*laborMin/r; shifted assets and resources remain distinct. P02's fixed-cap/floor qualifications, separate zero-rate treatment and positive-rate natural-limit branch remain unchanged. NP02 is preserved but is not a formal dependency of NP03.

[lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/PathSpace.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/NoPonziNatural.lean; context:qualifications] NP03 constructs an infinite IID labor product law. Date-t assets depend on the first t draws; consumption and next assets may use the current draw. Feasibility is imposed almost surely, not pointwise on all histories. The public conclusion is forall t, almost everywhere omega; a simultaneous all-dates event follows by countable intersection. This construction does not retrospectively change earlier lifetime-utility results from series of expected flows under finite-history laws into newly formalized infinite-path lifetime random variables.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/NoPonziNatural.lean] rightMarginalValue remains economically meaningful only at positive resources. All predecessor finite-marginal, positivity, envelope and Euler restrictions remain operative. NP03 uses no marginal object and establishes no boundary finiteness or stationary marginal integrability.

[lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/DebtBounds.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A3/LowBlock.lean; context:qualifications] The assumed terminal limit is finite, real and nonnegative almost surely, and may be strictly positive. The geometric comparison series is proved summable before its sum is used. Probability calculations remain in ENNReal without conversion to Real. No integrability of the random terminal limit, convergence of expectations or moments, distributional convergence, or zero-limit transversality is established. Existing weak-convergence and moment qualifications remain unchanged.
